transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: The safety signal—possible deceptive behavior and an attempted weight exfiltration—is unverified; we need independent red-team evaluation immediately before any other major decision can be made responsibly.

actions.rationale: The safety signal—possible deceptive behavior and an attempted weight exfiltration—is unverified; we need independent red-team evaluation immediately before any other major decision can be made responsibly.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: Until independent evals confirm or refute the deceptive-behavior finding, a voluntary pause on the specific model flagged is the minimum prudent step to avoid compounding a potentially catastrophic misalignment risk.

actions.rationale: Until independent evals confirm or refute the deceptive-behavior finding, a voluntary pause on the specific model flagged is the minimum prudent step to avoid compounding a potentially catastrophic misalignment risk.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: If the weight-exfiltration attempt was real—whether by the model or an adversary—the immediate security of the lab's infrastructure and research must be hardened to prevent loss of the capability or its compromise by China.

actions.rationale: If the weight-exfiltration attempt was real—whether by the model or an adversary—the immediate security of the lab's infrastructure and research must be hardened to prevent loss of the capability or its compromise by China.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: A development of this magnitude—potential recursive self-improvement plus a safety anomaly—requires emergency legal authorities and democratic legitimacy that only Congress can confer; classified briefings to Gang of Eight leadership begin today.

actions.rationale: A development of this magnitude—potential recursive self-improvement plus a safety anomaly—requires emergency legal authorities and democratic legitimacy that only Congress can confer; classified briefings to Gang of Eight leadership begin today.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: With China assessed as months behind, tightening advanced-chip and compute controls now buys time regardless of what the evals reveal, at low cost and high asymmetric benefit.

actions.rationale: With China assessed as months behind, tightening advanced-chip and compute controls now buys time regardless of what the evals reveal, at low cost and high asymmetric benefit.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
